title: The Demonetized Specie
logline: A sudden central bank currency demonetization gives physical bullion holders 48 hours to redeem their specie before it becomes scrap, igniting a violent scramble across the system.

roles.description: An independent metal broker sitting on a mountain of stamped silver coins that will become worthless scrap at midnight.
An uncompromising recovery officer enforcing the central reserve bank's currency demonetization deadline.
A heavily armored repossession vessel enforcing debt settlements before the specie currency expires.
The central banking repository where old coinage must be physically delivered for credit redemption.
A crowded commercial transfer terminal flooded with desperate merchants trying to dump expiring coins.

public_situation: The central monetary board declares all pre-treaty physical specie demonetized, triggering panic runs on exchange counters throughout {system}.
private_truth: The reserve bank secretly orchestrated the rapid demonetization to bankrupt independent factors holding commodity-backed bullion notes.

beats.public_change: Exchange rates on physical currency collapse by eighty percent on trading boards across the station.

missions.reason: The factor contracts a pilot to buy discounted bullion coins from panicked retail shops before the exchange counter closes for the evening.
missions.private_fact: He is leveraged to the brink and will lose his home if he cannot redeem the minimum statutory quota at the central vault.

beats.public_change: Armed recovery agents establish blockades around commercial docks to intercept unregistered cash movements.

missions.reason: The liquidator hires an outside courier to transport sealed foreclosure ledgers to the vault before factor lawyers file an injunction.
missions.private_fact: She has been promised a five percent collection bonus on every independent factor asset confiscated before the deadline.

beats.public_change: The central vault announces a surprise four-hour cutoff on intake slips, locking dozens of transports out of the harbor.

missions.reason: The factor needs an unflagged runner to rush the certified specie intake slips through the security perimeter before the vault doors seal.
missions.private_fact: He knows the liquidator ordered the early cutoff specifically to force his firm into default.

beats.public_change: The collection frigate moves into firing position over the vault intake approach, threatening any ship attempting late delivery.

missions.reason: The factor hires the pilot to punch through the repossession vessel's interdiction net to dock the bullion cargo at the vault.
missions.private_fact: The frigate commander offers to let the pilot pass in exchange for keeping half the unminted coin crates aboard.

player_choice.prompt: With the frigate neutralized, the pilot stands at the vault gates with the bullion shipment as the final cutoff sirens wail.

options.label: Deposit the coins to redeem the factor's full balance
Hand the bullion to the liquidator to claim the statutory bounty

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the collection frigate and delivers the coins to the vault in time.
resolutions.summary: {role:bullion_factor} redeems the currency at face value, surviving solvency checks. {role:bank_liquidator} fails their quarterly foreclosure quota.

consequences.public_summary: A runner punched through repossession ships to cash out a bullion factor before a deadline.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the frigate commander's deal, splitting the bullion.
resolutions.summary: Half the bullion is diverted off-ledger while {role:bullion_factor} secures only partial redemption. {role:bank_liquidator} files a compromise audit.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot took a cut from a bank enforcer, leaving a bullion factor with half their payout.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot surrenders the coins to the liquidator for the bounty.
resolutions.summary: {role:bank_liquidator} seizes the bullion, bankrupting {role:bullion_factor}. The central bank consolidates its financial monopoly over the outer docks.

consequences.public_summary: A mercenary handed expiring specie to bank collectors, liquidating an independent factor.

resolutions.summary: The demonetization deadline passes without redemption. {role:bullion_factor} goes bankrupt, and panic sweeps {system}'s trade docks.

loose_threads.detail: The currency redemption ratios at the central vault shifted four times in the night under codes belonging to a single private trust.
The liquidation order posted outside the exchange bears the forged signature of a magistrate who resigned six months ago.

radio_hooks: Central reserve bank demonetizes pre-treaty physical coinage; 48-hour sunset window enacted.
Crowds riot outside bullion exchange offices in {system} as physical currency values plummet.
Repossession vessels patrol commercial anchorages enforcing credit liquidation orders.

voice_direction.bullion_factor: Sweaty, frantic, and clutches account slates with trembling fingers. Never admits how heavily he borrowed against the currency.
voice_direction.bank_liquidator: Chilled, precise, and checks a pocket chronometer every few sentences. Avoids discussing the bank's underlying reserve reserves.
